column_description: ID of the motion path the step belongs to. may be NULL.
Number of the step in the path. may be NULL.
Name of the step (e.g., start, end, intermediate points). always exactly one of 'start', 'end', 'intermediate points'. may be NULL.
X coordinate of the step. may be NULL.
Y coordinate of the step. may be NULL.
Z coordinate of the step. may be NULL.
Timestamp when the step was recorded. may be NULL.
Velocity of the robot at the step. may be NULL.
Acceleration of the robot at the step. may be NULL.
